_description: Multiservizi ANIP (CNEL K511) level 2, March 2026 regular run, permanent, full time: the frozen contingenza and the EDR of the renewal of 8 June 2021, signed by ANIP.
_notes: Indennità di contingenza 513.96 and E.D.R. 10.33 at level 2 in the art. 73 table 'Con decorrenza 1 luglio 2025' (CNEL idAccordo 139292, page 34), unchanged since July 2021 (page 32).
Fixed allowances only: the file pays the tabellare of the renewal of 13 June 2025, which ANIP did not sign (limitation anip_unsigned_renewal), so the base salary and the gross are not pinned.
